summary: The lr group was first packaged as 8-unit requests (2026-10-11/12; lrc as 3-unit). Most first-pass requests were refused at launch by the shared fleet's BATCH_MAX_CONCURRENT_INSTANCES cap; every 8-unit request that did run hit the fleet's 3600 s job poweroff and returned all units as batch_job_timeout with no measurements; several clients were stopped by outer wall-clock limits while their jobs kept running (klt sim batch has no re-attach, so those results were never collected). Three first-pass requests returned and are reused verbatim because their request and netlist bytes are identical to the 3-unit packaging (marked 'reused'). The record's rows come only from the 3-unit request set; no other attempt below contributed a unit.
